     3.Description of the spirit drink

              Title - Product name                   Valley Plum
              Physical, chemical and/or              Valley Plum is a colourless spirit distilled from
              organoleptic characteristics           fermented plums of the valley orchards, with a
                                                     minimum strength of 40 % vol.
                                                     Appearance: clear and bright.
                                                     Taste: round, with a long finish.
              Specific characteristics               Its almond note comes from stones left in the
              (compared to spirit drinks             mash during fermentation.
              of the same category)                  No sugar and no colouring are added.
                                                     The spirit rests three months before bottling.

     4.Define geographical area
          a.Description of the defined geographical area

              The area is the whole of the province of Northshire and the
              municipality of Southford.

          b.NUTS area

              ES612                                  Cádiz
              ES61                                   Andalucía
              ES6                                    SUR
              ES                                     ESPAÑA



     5.Method for obtaining the spirit drink

              Title - Type of method                 Double distillation
              Method                                 The plums are picked ripe, mashed whole and
                                                     fermented for three weeks. The mash is distilled
                                                     twice in copper pot stills of at most 1 000 litres.

     6.Link with the geographical environment or origin

              Title - Product name                   Valley Plum
              Details of the geographical            The valley floor is sheltered from the north wind
              area or origin relevant to the         and its loam soils hold water through dry summers,
              link                                   so the plums ripen late and sweet.
                                                     Orchards have been recorded here since 1720.
                                                     Every farm kept a small copper still.
              Specific characteristics of the        The late harvest gives the high sugar the spirit's
              spirit drink attributable to           full body depends on.
              the geographical area                  Slow distillation keeps the stone-fruit aroma.
                                                     The reputation of the drink dates from the fairs
                                                     of the nineteenth century.

     7.European Union or national/regional provisions

              Title                                  Spirit Drinks Act
              Legal reference                        Official Gazette 61/2009

     9.Specific labelling rules

              Title                                  Age statements
              Description of the rule                'Old' only after two years in oak.
